description: This source file defines a test class for caching and retrieving silo metadata within Orleans's placement filtering tests. It implements the ISiloMetadataCache interface and provides a simple in-memory cache mechanism.

classes.name: TestSiloMetadataCache
classes.description: A test implementation of ISiloMetadataCache that stores silo metadata in a dictionary for use in unit tests.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves the metadata for a given SiloAddress, returning a cached value or a default empty metadata if not found.
